items.claim: The close verse of this span ends on the ground-clause of the verdict that opens the unit after it. oshb:Ezek.29.9 carries the recognition refrain and then a because-clause that re-quotes the river boast of oshb:Ezek.29.3, and oshb:Ezek.29.10 opens with the answering therefore-clause of that same sentence, the river word recurring inside it as a suffixed plural. But the second half of that close verse is the protasis of oshb:Ezek.29.10; the witness puts its paragraph division two verses earlier, after oshb:Ezek.29.7, where a therefore-plus-messenger-formula onset stands at oshb:Ezek.29.8 and the reed-staff figure is complete at oshb:Ezek.29.7; and no mark stands at the close chosen here. The rule that a messenger formula cuts a unit only on an addressee change or a refrain close immediately before it settles this against the cut, so the span holds and medium is the right level.
